reason: The right diagram is compact, clearly labeled and color-coded with a stat-card summary, while the left diagram has long sparse routing lines and tiny mono labels, though the right diagram is cropped on phone.

The right flowchart uses color-coded urgent and routine lanes with pill badges and cleaner tables and cards, while the left flowchart has long awkward connector lines and oversized serif card text.

The right architecture diagram is compact and legible, and it adds a to-scale link-capacity bar and a highlighted table, while the left diagram is long and stretched with tiny labels, although the right is cropped on phone.

The right diagram is clearer, with grouped regions and a legend, and it adds a scale bar chart and a flow table, while the left diagram has long lines and tiny type, despite phone cropping and a small label collision in the right chart.
The right page has a stronger hierarchy with a recommended-option card, a larger well-scaled bar chart and color-coded trade-off cards, while the left page is plainer with a small chart.

The left range chart is large and legible, with a goal line and hatched below-goal segments, and it adds verdict cards and a clear hierarchy, while the right chart is small and the page is a plain list.

The left page has a best-value comparison table, big to-scale bars, stat callouts and a timeline chart, while the right page has a basic table and one chart, although the left table is cropped on phone.

The left page has clean option cards, a large bar chart and a can and cannot-do card grid with a clear recommendation, while the right page is plainer and its nurse triage option sits outside the cards.

The right page has clean, legible charts and tables with no overlaps, while the left charts have labels colliding with the goal line and bars, a truncated axis label and a cropped phone table, even though the left page is otherwise more polished.
